name: Blue Apron (meal kits)
title: Was Blue Apron too early? No: HelloFresh grew
question: Was Blue Apron too early for meal kits?
answer: Blue Apron went public in 2017 and was sold to Wonder in 2023 for about $103M, a fraction of its IPO value. HelloFresh sold meal kits in the same markets over the same years and became the category leader. Meal kits worked; one company's customer economics did not.
verdict_reason: HelloFresh grew in the same market over the same years.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.

graveyard.name: Blue Apron
graveyard.how: Sold to Wonder for about $103M in 2023
